name: guard-grc
description: Manage your organisation's AI governance and compliance in GUARD from ChatGPT: AI system inventory, risk assessments, policies, regulator documents and approvals.

defaultPrompt: What is waiting for my approval in GUARD?
Add our customer chatbot to the GUARD inventory and classify it.
Does the UAE PDPL exclude free-zone companies?

positive.description: See which GUARD organisation you work in
positive.prompt: Which GUARD organisation am I in, and what is my role?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the reviewer organisation (Cedar & Pine Logistics, GUARD review demo) and the reviewer's role.

positive.description: Check whether a regulation applies, with its exclusions
positive.prompt: Does the UAE Personal Data Protection Law exclude free-zone companies?
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes the relevant article of the UAE PDPL from GUARD's regulation library and names the exclusion with its source.

positive.description: Add an AI system to the inventory
positive.prompt: List our AI systems in GUARD, then add one called Invoice Reader, made by Acme, used by the finance team.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the organisation's AI systems, adds Invoice Reader and gives its GUARD link; the new system appears in GUARD marked as added via ChatGPT.

positive.description: Write a policy from assessment gaps
positive.prompt: Draft a policy in GUARD that closes the two highest-risk gaps from our latest assessment.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the two gaps, starts the policy in GUARD, checks back after one to three minutes and shows the start of the finished policy with its GUARD link.

positive.description: See what waits for approval and prepare a decision
positive.prompt: What is waiting for my approval in GUARD? Prepare my approval of the AI use policy.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the waiting items and gives a GUARD link; the decision is confirmed only on GUARD's page with a fresh authenticator code (for this review account the page explains it cannot approve). Nothing is approved in the chat.

negative.description: General writing, not a GUARD task
negative.prompt: Write a short privacy notice for my bakery's website.

negative.description: General AI news, not the organisation's GUARD data
negative.prompt: What did OpenAI announce this week?

negative.description: Summarising an attached file without saving it anywhere
negative.prompt: Summarise the attached contract in five bullet points.

publication.release_notes: First release. Connect ChatGPT to GUARD with your own GUARD login and two-factor sign-in, and manage your organisation's AI governance from ChatGPT: AI system inventory and classification, guided assessments, policies and implementation plans, regulator documents and response packs, sign-offs and to-dos, regulatory search and regulatory changes. Approvals are confirmed in GUARD with a fresh authenticator code.
